name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Tay Roc vs. Hollow Da Don, y'all! That second round? The 'Seatbelt' bar? That's history, plain and simple.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Hollow's second? It's up there.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: 'Up there'? Tasha, that wasn't just 'up there,' that was a damn supernova!

name: TASHA RAW
line: Marcus. Impact's in the receipts. Ill Will's round two? The Emmett Till scheme? That's the URL's receipt.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Whew.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Hollow's second? That's the argument? King, you're still stuck on the undercard. We talkin' 'bout the MAIN EVENT!

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Hm.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Mm.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Whew.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Whew.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Y'all naming moments. I'm asking about the fight that built the fighter.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Okay, King. So tell me how Hollow builds him more than Ill Will did?

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Mm.

name: TASHA RAW
line: So we're saying there isn't one.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: There ISN'T one? Y'all heard that? Nah, that's wild. We talkin' legendary rounds here!

name: TASHA RAW
line: Wild, sure. But. Figured out what 'legendary' pays?

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Face of the URL! That's the main event, y'all! With iconic haymakers, not just talk.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Iconic haymakers ain't born in main events. They're forged in the first fire that proves what you are. So the real question is: what fight made Tay Roc a gunner?

name: TASHA RAW
line: That's your fast track, Marcus. But the receipts...

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: The receipts are Hollow, Tasha! His greatest round is STILL the one that blew the roof off the building!

name: TASHA RAW
line: Okay, Marcus. Your roof. Still, I check the foundation.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Foundation? Tasha, that 'Seatbelt' round IS the foundation! It's why he's even got a roof to check!

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: The foundation ain't one round. It's the fight that made the URL see him as a gunner. That's DNA.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Cap.

name: TASHA RAW
line: And who won, Marcus?

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: The tape don't care who won. It cares who you became after.

name: TASHA RAW
line: But who you became, King? That's URL's receipt: Ill Will battle, second round. Periodt.
delivery: dry. precise. throws it back at him

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: I'll give you the foundation of the URL argument. But that Hollow battle? That's the whole damn building. He won that, 2-1.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Your building. My blueprint.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: Mm.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: That 'other half' rebuttal ain't just a moment. It's the birth certificate for the gunner.

name: TASHA RAW
line: Yeah. And birth certificates. They show first breath. Still prove first fight. Ill Will was his.

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: First breath is the baby. First fight is the man. DNA was the first time he had to be the man.

name: TASHA RAW
line: But baby, DNA's first breath? Still earned Hollow the house, right?

name: KING KNOWLEDGE
line: The house was built off the blueprint. DNA was the blueprint.

name: MARCUS BLAZE
line: Blueprint? King, you're talking about the blueprints while the house is burning down! That Hollow battle IS the fire!
